llms.body:
# Photoroom

> Photoroom is an AI-powered background remover and image editing platform.  
> It enables users to create professional-quality visuals through AI-assisted tools.  
> It empowers e-commerce businesses and brands to easily create consistent visuals.

1. Photoroom provides a suite of AI-powered image editing tools.
2. Users can remove backgrounds and enhance images.
3. Brands can create visuals and product photography with ease.

## Related Documentation

- [About Photoroom](https://photoroom.com/about): Overview of the platform.
- [Help Center](https://photoroom.com/help): Guides for using Photoroom's tools.
- [AI Tools] (https://www.photoroom.com/tools): All AI tools provided by Photorooms
- [Background Remover](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/background-remover): Remove the backgrounds of your photos.
- [Add Background] (https://www.photoroom.com/tools/instant-backgrounds): Add a background to your images.
- [Blur Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/blur-background): Blur the background of your photos online.
- [White Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/white-background): Make any photo background white.
- [Change Background Color](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/change-background-color): Change the background color of any photo.
- [Add Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/add-background): Add backgrounds to your photos.
- [Black Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/black-background): Make any photo
  background black.
- [Transparent Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/transparent-background): Make transparent backgrounds online.
- [Black & White Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/black-white-background): Make a black and white background.
- [Remove Object from Photo](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/remove-object-from-photo): Erase objects from your photos.
- [Instant Shadows](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/instant-shadows): Add shadows to product photos.
- [AI Expand](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/ai-expand): Expand your image with AI.
- [Photo Enhancer](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/photo-enhancer): Enhance your photo quality with AI.
- [Batch Mode](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/batch-mode): Edit multiple photos at once.
- [Image Brightener](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/image-brightener): Brighten your photos.
- [Change Color in Image](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/change-color-image): Change color in images.
- [AI Images](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/ai-images): Create AI images from text.
- [Create a Logo](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-a-logo): Create a logo with AI.
- [Create Text Visuals](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-text-visuals): Create text visuals with AI.
- [Create Icon](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-icon): Create an icon with AI.
- [Create Poster](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-poster): Create posters with AI.
- [Create Birthday Card](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-birthday-card): Create birthday cards with AI.
- [Create Quote Visuals](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/create-quote-visuals): Generate quote visuals.
- [Add Text to Photo](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/add-text-photo): Add text to photos.
- [Curved Text](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/curved-text): Create curved text.
- [Signature Maker](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/signature-maker): Create a signature.
- [Outline Pictures](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/outline-pictures): Outline pictures online.
- [Black & White Filter](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/black-white-filter): Convert photos to black and white.
- [Motion Blur Effect](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/motion-blur-effect): Add motion blur to photos.
- [Sepia Filter](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/sepia-filter): Add sepia filter to photos.
- [Add Stickers to Photo](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/add-stickers-to-photo): Add stickers to photos.
- [WhatsApp Sticker Creator](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/whatsapp-sticker-creator): Create WhatsApp stickers.
- [Image Resizer](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/image-resizer): Resize images online.
- [Customize Background](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/customize-background): Customize photo backgrounds.
- [Round Profile Picture](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/round-profile-picture): Make round profile pictures.
- [Profile Picture Maker](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/profile-picture-maker): Create profile pictures.
- [Resize for Instagram](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/resize-for-instagram): Resize photos for Instagram.
- [Bulk Resize Images](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/bulk-resize-images): Resize multiple images at once.
- [Promote your business] (https://www.photoroom.com/use-cases/promote-your-business): Promote your business with Photoroom

- [Create a brand kit])https://www.photoroom.com/brand-kit): Create your brand kit with Photoroom

- [Get your API key](https://www.photoroom.com/api): Get your Photoroom'sAPI key

Scaling businesses

Batch edit your products, publish them directly to Shopify and turn them into video ads, with your brand consistent across every channel, in the app or through the API.
Start for free

Contact sales

– Sonia Biddle, Chief Product Officer, Depop
Testimonials

Trusted by the brands selling at first sight

See all stories

99% cost reduction per image

"Without Photoroom, we would not have been able to guarantee a constant quality level across our large image volume. We also would have missed the six-figures savings made possible by cutting the workload to a quarter through automation."

Matthieu ChatelainDigital Project Manager
Read the story
See all stories
For teams that ship at scale

Built for visual production at scale

    • Batch editing at catalog scale: Thousands of images in one job, from the web app or the API.

    • Automated QA, not manual review: Brand rules apply on upload, so checks that took hours run in minutes.

    • One master image, every channel: Marketplace, DTC, resale, and delivery formats from a single run.

    • One queue for every source: PIM, DAM, API, seller, and supplier inputs all flow into the same pipeline.

    • Brand Library locks your rules: Backgrounds, padding, colors, logos, and formats applied automatically, with role-based access.

    • Edits that stay true to the product: Models built for e‑commerce hold the real product, so what ships matches what arrives.

    • Backed by Enterprise Guarantee: Pay only for outputs that pass your fidelity criteria set upfront. Anything that doesn't is regenerated or credited back.

    • Custom AI models tuned to your catalog: Trained on your products and brand rules, on Enterprise contracts.

    • A REST API that adopts new models: Endpoint-level control with your Brand Library rules applied, so the same workflow runs as models evolve.

    • Connects to your stack, across every surface: Native PIM, DAM, and cloud connectors, on API, web, and mobile.

    • Usage dashboards: Track credits per key, feature, and user, with alerts before exhaustion.
